notes.title: 《Bronze Blade Argent Sword》the crowdfunding campaign is about to launch!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45288064/19a07d128360bbe690bb6f92f24389c30e85dc5d.png[/img]
Hello fellow players,
Since the launch of the store page,《Bronze Blade Argent Sword》 has accumulated thousands of wishlists and demo plays. We deeply appreciate your support and enthusiasm, which motivates our four-person team to keep pushing forward.

Additionally, our crowdfunding campaign for merchandise and game keys is launching as scheduled! The merchandise includes acrylic stands, wall scrolls, keychains, art prints, mouse pads, and even body pillows! A giveaway event will also kick off simultaneously—don’t miss out!

Thank you all once again for your incredible support!
